rules.broad_trigger: transaction semantics or externally visible checkpoint contract changes
commit/rollback, mass, time or public kernel contract changes
physics, numerical policy, convergence status, precision or solver contract changes
state, flux, mass, physics or corrected-reference behavior can change
dispatch, isolation, result binding, concurrency or externally visible runtime contract changes
always when a reference blob, snapshot, manifest or oracle definition changes
only when an executable contract, provenance lock or qualification decision is changed

unmapped_surfaces: src/legacy/b1_10_port/** requires finer process-level ownership mapping
precision-policy surfaces are not yet explicitly declared in repository metadata
F-MQ qualification harnesses exist on non-baseline branches and are not executable from this checkout
selection_contract: A selector is advisory until a focused F-TA qualification proves its completeness.
Unknown or overlapping ownership expands the test cone; it never suppresses a test.
A physics, numerical-policy, precision, state-layout or transaction-semantics change requires explicit human declaration.
Qualification tests require their own exact source binding and cannot inherit the F-TA branch HEAD.
